component.name: Fmail
component.summary: Private email, sorted on your device

description.p: An open-source mail app that keeps your mail between you and your mail server. No account with us, no servers of ours, no analytics.

ul.li: Smart Inbox: Important, General, Notifications and Newsletters, sorted on your device
Remote images and trackers blocked; mail shown without a web browser engine
Mail stored encrypted; passwords only in the system keychain
Custom folders with rules, drafts on your server, undo send
